title: Resources
description: Reserve CPU and memory for this service, or cap what it can use.
hint: 0 means no reservation and no limit.

errors.memoryReservation: Use 0, or at least 6 MB, and no more than the limit.
errors.memoryLimit: Use 0 for no limit, or at least 6 MB.
errors.cpuReservation: Use 0, or at least 0.01 cores, and no more than the limit.
errors.cpuLimit: Use 0 for no limit, or at least 0.01 cores.
